request.instructions:
You write short re-cleaning requests for a cleaner. For each item below write one request.

Rules:
- Write each request in English plus an English version for the host.
- For a problem item: say what to fix and ask for a new photo afterwards.
- For an item that needs proof: say exactly what to photograph.
- Keep each request to one sentence.
- Examples (in English): "Clean the stain at the back of the microwave and send a new photo." / "Send a photo of the hand towel in the guest bathroom."

Items:
- powder-room.toilet_paper (Powder room): New roll on the holder - A new, full toilet paper roll on the holder next to the toilet (a folded end is fine) [status: problem - Toilet paper roll on holder is partly used, not new and full.]
- powder-room.sink (Powder room): Sink and mirror clean - Sink and mirror are clean [status: needs proof - No photo shows it]
- powder-room.hand_towel (Powder room): Hand towels hanging - 1 clean hand towel hanging, one at each sink (a reflection in the mirror does not count) [status: needs proof - No photo shows it]
- powder-room.hand_soap (Powder room): Hand soap at the sink - A hand soap dispenser at the sink [status: needs proof - No photo shows it]
- powder-room.spare_toilet_paper (Powder room): Spare roll in the bathroom - Besides the roll on the holder, at least one spare toilet paper roll, for example on the toilet tank (the photo shows at least 2 rolls) [status: needs proof - Checks disagree]
- powder-room.no_guest_items (Powder room): No guest items left - No guest items left on the sink or the floor [status: needs proof - No photo shows it]
